Nana Patekar's 'Evil Dead' comment sparks controversy

Actress Tanushree Dutta referred to actor Nana Patekar as 'Evil Dead'. Following reports of Patekar's death, the All India Cine Workers Association (AICWA) criticized Dutta for her earlier comment, calling it "cheap publicity" and stating that "the country has lost its child."
